main_text.p: שָׁרַךְ Pihel Implicare, quasi cum שָׁרַג con-veniens; literis ג & כ permutatis: מְשָׁרְכָה Implicans, Jer.2.24.
שָׁרוּעַ שָׁרַע m. Pralongus, Redundans membris. Hithpahel הִשְׁתָּרַע Redundare.
שָׂרַף Urere, Comburere, Exurere, Incendere. Niphal נִשְׂרַף & Pyhal שֻׂרַף Comburi, Exuri.
שָׂרָף m. Præster, Serpens ignitus: plurale, שְׂרָפִים. Est & Seraphim angelorum nomen, qui à claritate & splendore quasi Flammantes aut ignei dicti.
מִשְׂרָפָה שְׂרֵפָה f. Incendium, Combustio, ustio: plur. מִשְׂרָפוֹת Combustiones.
שָׁרַץ Repere, Reptare, Abundè progignere vel producere; inslar reptilium, quasi Reptificare dicas.
שָׁרָק שֹׂרֶק Vitis generosa. Fœm: שְׂרֵקָה. שֹׂרְקִים.

page.notes: Hebrese vowel points and some letters are approximated from a faded scan; Latin text is clear. Page is damaged by stains at the right and lower margin.
